thread:
maya: Hey team — planning the launch webinar + benchmark page for May 12. Need a compact benchmark tile system (modular cards for latency/cost/quality) + a hero diagram that explains 'Redwood inference routing' simply. Also need brand sign-off before we start motion. Can you take this, @jonah and @alex?

jonah: I can own the tiles and hero. Quick q: do you want static PNGs + SVGs, or also a set of animated GIFs/Lottie for the webinar CTA?

maya: PNG + SVG for site, 1 GIF (600–800ms loop) for social/webinar intro. Also need Figma templates so other PMs can swap numbers.

alex: Heads-up — new illustration style guidance lives here: https://figma.com/file/brand-guidelines (use 2.0 icon set, avoid gradients). Also: accessibility check required for color pairs (contrast >= 4.5). Don't use "best" or comparative superlatives without benchmark source callouts.

jonah: got it re: style + contrast. Can you confirm the primary tile fields we should include? thinking: model, vCPU/GPU cost per 1k tokens, median latency @N, recommended quantization, and a short note on quality (1-line).

maya: exactly. Also add a small badge for 'Hosted / Dedicated / Private' routing and a tiny tooltip copy for methodology link. Export sizes: tile compact (370x220), tile wide (740x220), hero (1200x600).

sam: For inbound routing — make sure each tile includes a hidden data attribute with campaign id so we can A/B route leads to different forms. Example attribute name: data-campaign="benchmark-2026-05". We need UTM variants for the webinar CTA buttons too.

jonah: thanks — adding that to the Figma component. Will include a variant for localized copy (EN/DE/FR) and a small layer called "data-attrs" for dev export.

alex: Brand rules: typography must use Redwood Sans for headings and Inter for body, do not convert type to outlines in the source file, and keep icon stroke at 2px. For any chart, avoid log-scale visuals that could mislead — use linear, label axes with units.

maya: timeline — first pass by Tue (2159900000), feedback round Wed, final exports Fri. Can we hit that?

jonah: yes. I'll push a Figma file and drop exports.

design-bot: Uploaded file: https://figma.com/file/abc123/benchmark-tiles-v1 — components + export presets.

jonah: quick export instructions I added to the Figma notes:
```
Export presets:
- Tiles: SVG (icon-only), PNG @1x, PNG @2x
- Hero: SVG + PNG @2x (1200px width)
- GIF: 800x450, 60fps, 700–900ms loop
Naming convention: redwood_bench_{variant}_{size}_{locale}.png  e.g. redwood_bench_compact_370x220_en.png
Dev attrs: component > props > "data-campaign" and "utm_source=webinar"
```

alex: Looks good. I'll review for brand compliance Tue morning and flag anything. If anything changes, I'll post specific color/token overrides.

maya: perfect — @sam will coordinate dev hooking for routing and landing page. Thanks everyone :rocket:

sam: I'll set the campaign stub and make sure the form variants are ready. ping me when GIF is final.

jonah: will do, dropping an initial art board by EOD.

maya: thanks — marking this thread as the single source for creative assets. Please keep comments in the Figma file for iteration.
